title: Bedmap: Antarctic ice thickness, bed and surface elevation
description: Cloud-optimized copies of the Bedmap gridded products for Antarctica, with virtual multidimensional indexes (GDAL VRT, Kerchunk, Icechunk, STAC). Currently holds Bedmap3: 500 m grids in EPSG:3031 of ice thickness, bed and surface elevation, uncertainty, survey counts and a surface type mask. Repackaged from the UK Polar Data Centre release (doi:10.5285/2d0e4791-8e20-46a3-80e4-f5f6716025d2), CC BY 4.0.
